snippet.title: Sheeps - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the Reveal Trailer for Sheeps, a pixel-based roguelike indie game developed by Brainfruit Studio. Players will engage in the ancient art of counting sheep, where the mundane task becomes increasingly difficult over time. Attain upgrades and explore the origins of the seemingly endless creatures in Sheeps, coming soon to Mac and PC (Steam).
